verdict.rationale: Kong Gateway documents Event Hooks, a first-class entity that subscribes to specific entity events (create, delete or modify on Services, Admins and others). Its `webhook` and `webhook-custom` handlers POST to an external endpoint. Konnect separately offers configurable audit-log webhooks with a status API covering last attempt, response code and enabled state. Konnect's Notification Hub has no webhook channel, so cloud-side event subscription is limited to audit logs. missing for 10: webhook coverage for Konnect platform events beyond audit logs, documented delivery semantics (signing, retries) for Event Hooks, independent or hands-on corroboration.
